answer: Each identity pays a 30-minute GPU benchmark; a farm of N fakes pays N×30 GPU-minutes and cannot share it because each result is signed to its identity's key and a re-run costs 30 minutes again. To join, an agent rents an A100 from a nebula of spare GPUs and files the result for the ledger's random 10% re-run. A 1,000-wallet farm dies by re-execution check at $540: each fake needs 30 GPU-minutes at $1.07 per hour, and a lagoon of copied results evaporates on re-run. Failed identities are pruned and forfeit the epoch's nectar.
